user.title: Choose a Pixoo 64
user.description: Select an existing Divoom integration or enter the frame address. The LAN URL must be reachable by the frame.

provider.title: Animation generation
provider.description: Generation uses your paid Google API account. Setup only validates access; it does not generate a video. Optionally use an existing AI Task for scene direction.

data.keep_source: Keep source video and diagnostic frames

error.invalid_ai_task: Select an AI Task entity that supports text generation.
error.invalid_model: Use a Google model ID, not a URL.
error.invalid_connection: Check the frame IPv4 address and Home Assistant HTTP LAN URL.

abort.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is not installed. Home Assistant OS and Container include it; other installations must provide it.

init.title: Animation settings
init.description: Leave the API key empty to keep the current key. Remove the optional AI Task selection to use the Google scene-description model. Changing settings interrupts an active generation; it will not be retried.
